title: Chance meetings, the destination paradox, and the social origins of travel
kernthese: Reiseentscheidungen entstehen durch soziale Einbettung, nicht rationale Destinationswahl.
key_quote: The social mechanisms generating visitor flows are more explanatory than push and pull factors.
anknuepfung: Supervisor's core paper. BA extends it: from pre-travel social origins to in-destination optimization.

title: The St. Gallen Model for Destination Management
authors: Beritelli, P., Reinhold, S., Laesser, C., & Bieger, T.
kernthese: Destinationsmanagement als soziales System, nicht hierarchische Steuerung.
anknuepfung: Foundational framework. BA operates within this model.

title: Nudge plus in tourism: reflexive behaviours and reflective attitudes
authors: Yachin, J. M., Margaryan, L., Lexhagen, M., & Ioannides, D.
kernthese: Nudge+ kombiniert reflexive Handlungen mit reflektiven Prozessen für nachhaltigen Verhaltenswandel.
key_quote: Nudge+ is an intervention that aims to influence consumer decisions and promote long-term behavioural change by facilitating reflexive actions alongside reflective processes.
anknuepfung: Core theory paper. Gap: all nudge-tourism studies focus on climate — nudging for WTP/experience quality missing.

title: Overtourism: a revenue management perspective
kernthese: Overtourism: shift from extensive (more tourists) to intensive growth (higher WTP, fewer guests).
key_quote: Overtourism provides destinations with opportunities to replace extensive growth with intensive growth.
anknuepfung: Context: why destinations need WTP optimization. Gap: non-pricing soft guidance tools.

title: Nudge, tourism, and decision-making: bibliometric review
kernthese: Bibliometric map of nudging in tourism — shows dominant themes and gaps.
anknuepfung: Shows the gap: WTP/experience quality nudging absent from literature.

title: Marketing responses to overtourism: strategic mapping and diagnostic review
kernthese: Marketing strategies for overtourism: taxonomy of interventions, most untested.
anknuepfung: Research gaps in soft guidance effectiveness. Legitimation for BA.

title: Service design for the destination tourism service ecosystem
authors: Gao, Y., Zhang, Q., Xu, X., Jia, F., & Lin, Z.
kernthese: Destination service design matches supply with demand at touchpoints across micro-meso-macro levels.
key_quote: The task of destination tourism service design is to match the destination supply system with the customer's demand.
anknuepfung: Touchpoints framework — where soft guidance intervenes.

title: Willingness to Pay in Tourism and Its Influence on Sustainability
kernthese: WTP in tourism is multidimensional: shaped by experience quality, service, sustainability perception.
key_quote: Determining tourists' willingness to pay enables tourism operators to price services, design tourism products, and create revenue models.
anknuepfung: WTP definition and implicit signals gap. RQ1 foundation.

title: Digital horizons: internet self-efficacy and senior tourist destination preferences
authors: Jia, Y., Li, X., Zhang, X., & Wei, W.
kernthese: Internet self-efficacy shapes destination preferences for senior tourists via autonomy perception.
anknuepfung: Weak parallel to WTP framing. Not directly relevant.

title: Explicit vs. implicit luxury tourism experience self-presentations
authors: Huang, M., Chen, Y., Zheng, X., & Zhou, L.
kernthese: Implicit self-presentation of luxury triggers value co-destruction in online communities.
anknuepfung: Explicit vs. implicit signals parallel — bridge to WTP signal typology.

title: Digital nudging for sustainable tourist behavior in new media
authors: Ni, C., Wang, H., & Zhang, L.
kernthese: Digital nudging via UI layers (information, participation, immersion) steers sustainable behavior.
anknuepfung: Direct bridge to Yachin 2024. UI as dynamic event-space transferable to physical experiencescape.

title: Authentic experiences and visitor stickiness at world natural heritage sites
authors: Cheng, M., Chen, Y., Li, X., & Zhou, G.
kernthese: Environmental and brand authenticity drive visitor stickiness — proxy for implicit WTP.
anknuepfung: Visitor stickiness as behavioural correlate of implicit WTP.

title: Tourist tax per night and hotel performance: quasi-experimental evidence
authors: Anguera-Torrell, O., Muñoz-García, M., & Vives-Perez, J.
kernthese: Industry-promoted tourist tax has no significant effect on hotel performance.
anknuepfung: Foil: direct pricing tools don't work — supports soft guidance argument.
